theme_strategy: Warm Indian Road-Trip (Organic & Earthy + High Contrast). No default Vercel-look. Replaces sterile corporate blue with warm amber, cream, and deep charcoal. Emotionally evokes trust, safety, and a premium localized travel experience.

headings.weights: Light (300) for oversized text, SemiBold (600) for primary headings

rules: H1 size max text-5xl md:text-6xl. Do not exceed.
Overlines must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], tiny (text-xs)
Never use pure black #000000, use text_primary #1C1917 instead.
CTA Buttons (Booking) should use primary_brand. WhatsApp CTAs must use accent_whatsapp.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Solid Neumorphism. High-end surfaces with solid background colors and 1px delicate borders (border-border_light) to ground elements. Use soft, diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-sm or shadow-lg). No muddy transparent grays.
visual_enhancers.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 with a 1px solid bottom border border-stone-200. Never fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle roundness, max 12px (rounded-xl) for cards, rounded-full for buttons.

layouts.hero_section: Asymmetric Bento Grid (Mode A). Split the hero. Left side: Heavy text (Outfit font) + Booking form layered. Right side: Large rounded image of SUV on sunset road with subtle parallax.
layouts.services_grid: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Cardless or 1px border flat cards. Left-aligned text.
layouts.fleet_showcase: Horizontal wide cards on desktop (image on left, specs/price on right), stacked on mobile. Emphasize spaciousness with generous padding (p-8).
layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. py-20 or py-24 for section paddings. gap-8 to gap-12 for flex/grid layouts.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (translate-y-[-2px], shadow-md).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform duration-300 ease-out. NO transition-all.

component_guidelines.booking_form: Floating solid surface card (bg-white shadow-xl rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8). Use customized Shadcn Select and Input components. Form submission must save to DB AND open WhatsApp with pre-filled message.
component_guidelines.whatsapp_button: Sticky floating bottom-right. Must be highly visible, rounded-full, with pulse animation.
component_guidelines.testimonials: Carousel or Grid. Use large quote marks. Warm cream background cards.
component_guidelines.why_choose_us: Marquee strip or 4-column icon grid. Use Lucide icons (Shield, Clock, Map, CreditCard).

hero_background_or_side.description: White SUV on sunset road, ideal for hero section imagery.

fleet_suv.description: White SUV parked, suitable for Innova/SUV fleet card.

fleet_sedan.description: Grey sedan/SUV on highway, suitable for sedan fleet card.

driver_testimonial.description: Professional driver smiling. Use for 'Verified Drivers' or testimonials.

destination_monument.description: Indian monument/India gate architecture, use for Top Locations.

destination_ahmedabad.description: Ahmedabad city street with people, use for Top Locations (Ahmedabad).

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a modern, single-page website for 'Nishwa Tours & Travels' based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
Header must be sticky with business name/logo, Phone CTA, and WhatsApp button. Never use a fully transparent background for the header. Use backdrop-blur-xl with a cream tinted background.
Hero Section: Tagline 'OneWay Ride Anytime — AnyWhere from Ahmedabad', CTA 'Book Now' (WhatsApp), and hero car imagery.
Booking Form: Must include Name, Phone, Car Type (Sedan, SUV, Ertiga, Innova Crysta), Trip Type (One Way, Round Trip), Pickup, Drop, Date. Save to DB AND redirect to WhatsApp with pre-filled message.
Services Grid: One Way Cab, Round Trip, Local Rental, Outstation, Airport Transfer.
Top Locations Grid: Ahmedabad, Baroda, Surat, Rajkot, Udaipur, Mumbai, Pune, Gandhidham.
Why Choose Us: 24/7, Verified Drivers, Best Rates, Neat Cars, Transparent Billing.
Fleet Showcase: Cards for Sedan, SUV, Ertiga, Innova Crysta with pricing/features.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='booking-submit-button').
DO NOT output any .tsx code. You must output .js / .jsx code as the environment uses JavaScript.
Use pure Tailwind CSS + provided Shadcn components (customize their appearance using Tailwind to match the theme).
Avoid AI slop (no AI emojis like 🚀🤖, no purple gradients). Use the provided Unsplash images.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, but prefer solid neumorphism for this project.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (or .tsx if applicable, but output .js).
